title.en: Follow one route as far as it goes

brief.zh: 用栈记住还没有走完的岔路。先查最后放进去的节点，走不通时回到下一条岔路。
brief.en: Use a stack to remember branches that are still waiting. Try the last node you added, then return to another branch when a path ends.

title.en: Take the top of the stack first

body.zh: 用 append 把邻居压到栈顶，用 pop() 从顶上取下一个。最后压入的邻居会最先被查看。
body.en: Use append to put neighbors on the stack and pop() to take the next one from its top. The last neighbor added is the first one examined.

title.en: Record which nodes you have visited

body.zh: 有环的地图可能带你回到原处。用字典记下选过的节点，取出一个已访问的节点时就跳过它。
body.en: A cycle can take you back to an earlier node. Record visited nodes in a dictionary and skip any you have already handled.

body.zh: 当问题只问能不能到达，深度优先搜索可以一直探路。第一次找到的路线可能需要更多步。
body.en: Depth-first search can explore until it finds whether the goal is reachable. The first route it finds may take more steps.

prompt.zh: 先把 B 压入栈，再把 C 压入栈，下一次 pop() 会得到什么？
prompt.en: Push B, then push C. What does the next pop() return?

options.zh: B 和 C 同时返回

feedback.zh: 栈遵守后进先出。C 在栈顶，所以先拿到 C。
feedback.en: A stack is last in, first out. C is on top, so it comes out first.

caption.zh: 从 A 开始，把它放在栈顶。
caption.en: Start in room A and put it on the stack.

caption.zh: 取出 A，记下已经到过的房间。
caption.en: Pop A and record that this room has been visited.

caption.zh: A 有两条岔路。先把 B 放入等待栈。
caption.en: A has two branches. Push B onto the waiting stack first.

caption.zh: 再放入 C。C 在 B 的上面，所以下一次先处理 C。
caption.en: Push C next. It sits above B, so C is processed first.

caption.zh: 取出栈顶的 C。B 留在栈里，等这条岔路走完。
caption.en: Pop C. B waits on the stack while you follow this branch.

caption.zh: C 通往 D。把 D 压在 B 上面。
caption.en: C leads to D. Push D above B.

caption.zh: 来到 D。这条岔路到底了，栈里还记着 B。
caption.en: Visit D. This branch ends here, and B is still on the stack.

caption.zh: 取出一直在等待的 B。四个房间都看过了，栈也空了。
caption.en: Return to B, the room still waiting. All four rooms have been visited and the stack is empty.

label.en: Follow one route as far as it goes
